data.fund_type: An open-ended scheme tracking BSE Sensex Index
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to replicate the composition of the S&P BSE Sensex Index and to generate returns that are commensurate with the performance of the S&P BSE Sensex Index, subject to tracking errors. However, there is no guarantee or assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved.
data.exit_load: For exit on or before 15 days from the date of allotment – 0.20%; For exit after 15 days from the date of allotment – Nil
